newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Dec 12.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on December 12. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Industry and Trade Minister Tunky Ariwibowo said Indonesia was ready to take the national car policy before a panel of the World Trade Organisation (WTO) after negotiations with the United States and Japan in Geneva produced no results.

Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said he had not spent any of the 50 billion rupiah transfered from a state-owned coal mining company to his bank account in 1994. He said the transfer had been made with President Suharto's approval.

The trial of Budiman Sudjatmiko, leader of the People's Democratic Party (PRD) who was blamed for masterminding riots in Jakarta in July, is scheduled to start today. Muchtar Pakpahan, leader of the unrecognised Indonesian Labour Welfare Union (SBSI), will also appear in court today to face subversion charges linked to the riots.

President Suharto has agreed that Security and Political Affairs Minister Susilo Sudarman meet with Nobel peace laureate Bishop Carlos Belo of East Timor on his return from the Nobel awards ceremony in Oslo, Norway.
